tagline.en: Add precise camera-trajectory control to text-to-video diffusion — define the camera path and generate a clip that follows it.
tagline.zh: 为文生视频扩散模型加上精确的相机轨迹控制——定义镜头路径,生成沿其运动的片段。

en: CameraCtrl is a camera-control method for text-to-video generation. It lets you drive the camera along an explicit trajectory, so a generated clip moves through the scene the way you specify instead of with arbitrary motion.

You supply a text prompt together with a camera trajectory, and the model renders a video that honors that path. It works as a control layer on top of a video diffusion backbone, following the official trajectory-based demo contract.

In WorldFoundry, CameraCtrl runs through its in-tree synthesis backend on the shared pipeline: choose the checkpoint, provide a prompt and a trajectory, and it produces the trajectory-conditioned video.
zh: CameraCtrl 是面向文生视频的相机控制方法。它让你沿明确的轨迹驱动镜头,使生成片段按你指定的方式在场景中运动,而非随意移动。
你提供一段文本提示词以及一条相机轨迹,模型便会渲染出遵循该路径的视频。它作为控制层作用在视频扩散主干之上,遵循官方的基于轨迹的 demo 约定。
在 WorldFoundry 中,CameraCtrl 通过其内置合成后端在共享 pipeline 上运行:选好 checkpoint,给它提示词和轨迹,它就会生成受轨迹约束的视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for CameraCtrl when you want deliberate camera movement in generated video defined by a trajectory — pans, orbits and dollies you plan rather than leave to the model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望生成视频中的镜头运动由轨迹精心设计——摇镜、环绕、推轨都由你规划而非交给模型随意发挥时,选择 CameraCtrl。

notFor.en: Not needed if you don't care about camera motion — its purpose is trajectory control, so you have to supply a camera path. Checkpoints are downloaded separately as external assets.
notFor.zh: 如果你不在意镜头运动,则无需它——它的用途是轨迹控制,因此你必须提供相机路径。Checkpoint 作为外部资源需单独下载。

en: Control layer on top of a video diffusion backbone
Follows the official trajectory demo contract
Ships with both code and weights
zh: 面向文生视频的轨迹级相机控制
作用于视频扩散主干之上的控制层
遵循官方轨迹 demo 约定
